document.title: How to Wash a Lace Wig (Without Ruining the Hairline)
document.description: Step-by-step lace wig washing routine: detangle, cleanse, condition, dry, and keep lace intact.

body.raw:
## Before you wash
Detangle from ends to roots. Never scrub lace.

## Washing steps
1. Lukewarm water
2. Sulfate-free shampoo (light)
3. Condition mids-to-ends
4. Rinse gently
5. Pat dry, air dry on a stand

## Make it last longer
Wash less, style smarter, store properly.

## Quick answer
Lace front wigs look natural at the hairline. Full lace offers the most styling freedom (updos, parting anywhere).

## Lace front wigs
- Best for: beginners, daily wear, budget
- Strength: natural hairline
- Limitation: less freedom for high ponytails

## Full lace wigs
- Best for: updos, frequent styling changes
- Strength: part anywhere + maximum realism
- Tradeoff: cost + maintenance

## What to choose
If you want the easiest “natural look” start: lace front.  
If you want updos and versatility: full lace.
